welcomeLine: Ready to learn something new today? Today's lab simulations are waiting below.
emptyDashBody: They will be listed here when teachers send one.
resultsSubtitle: Academic assessment and roster summary center
rosterReady: Entered in the official roster archive
rosterLockedBody: Every subject for this semester is complete, and your class rank is recorded in the main archive.
rosterPendingBody: The semester and year summary is calculated after every teacher locks their marks. You can follow the current assessments now.
draftEmpty: There is no unfinished draft assessment. All of them are summarized.
lockedHeading: 2. Completed results locked into the roster
lockedEmpty: No subject is fully locked and approved yet.
draftHighBody: The mark is currently at a very high level. Keep your focus on the remaining assessments and hold this level.
draftMidBody: Work the remaining classwork and homework carefully so the mark can move higher.
draftLowBody: This assessment is below the pass mark. The result is not locked yet, so ask the teacher and close the gaps quickly.
finalExcellentBody: This subject is complete and has been entered in the main record at the highest level (Excellent).
finalVeryGoodBody: The subject is complete and archived. More effort next semester can raise it further.
finalPassBody: The result is locked. The next term still needs a stronger study plan.
finalFailBody: The final mark for this subject is locked at a low level. Speak with your homeroom teacher for extra support.
subject: Subject
groupsSubtitle: Group work assigned to you is here
leader: You are the leader of this group
noGroups: You have not been assigned to any group yet.
noSimsTitle: No simulation has been sent for your class.
noSimsBody: The list appears here when your teacher sends a virtual lab simulation.
noPublishedExams: No published exam for your class.
examWarningBody: This exam is allowed only in Safe Exam Browser (SEB). Open the SEB application first and enter through it.
quizNotInGroup: You are not in a group yet! Ask the teacher to add you to a group.
noActiveExam: There is no active exam right now.
waitTeacher: Please wait until the teacher starts the competition...
labSubtitle: Choose a subject and try it in practice
subject: Subject
attendanceHelp: Approved marks count as present, absent, or tardy. Pending marks stay on the list until they are approved.
disciplineHelp: Warnings, penalties, and commendations recorded for you.
timetableHelp: The weekly timetable for your section.
noticeHelp: Announcements addressed to students that are active today.
workHelp: Download notes shared with your class, and submit homework before the deadline.
skillHelp: Grades 7–8 explore vocational fields. Grades 9–10 choose one skill from the curriculum. Grades 11–12 continue that same skill.
bandExplore: You can look at the vocational fields for your grade. A trade is not chosen until grade 9.
bandChoose: Choose one vocational subject offered for your grade. A second choice is refused.
bandContinue: You continue the skill chosen in grades 9–10. A different trade is not open.
libraryHelp: A visit is 2 points, a returned book is 10, and a book kept past its return date costs 5. 20 points is a member. 50 is a scholar.
usageHelp: Each recorded visit to the library.
documentHelp: Grade 12 can request a transcript or another document. A new request waits until the open one is collected.
grade12Only: Transcript and document requests open in grade 12.
helpdeskHelp: Send a question to the school. The technician updates the status. You can close an open question.
title: Title
plannerHelp: This list is calculated from your own marks and approved absences. A subject under 50 gets 40 minutes. Three or more absences get 30 minutes. It is not a language model.
plannerClear: No subject needs extra time from your current marks and absences.
idHelp: Show this code at the school gate. The QR code contains your school student code.
